boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Franciscan University of Steubenville
boards.description: Ten current, under-21-safe Steubenville destinations with publicly posted late hours.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Sunset Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 2118 Sunset Blvd, Steubenville
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when you need a late food stop; the location posts drive-thru service until 4 a.m. every day.
cards.short_summary: A Sunset Boulevard drive-thru with the latest posted hours in this set.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours of 9 a.m.–4 a.m. Sunday through Saturday at 2118 Sunset Blvd.
cards.access_notes: Posted drive-thru hours are 9 a.m.–4 a.m. daily; dine-in hours differ.

cards.title: Domino’s on Sunset Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 2825 Sunset Blvd, Steubenville
cards.notes: Place a carryout or delivery order through the store page, which currently lists service until 1 a.m. today.
cards.short_summary: A pizza option whose official store page displays a 1 a.m. closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official Steubenville store page lists the 2825 Sunset Blvd location as open until 1 a.m. today.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 2825 Sunset Blvd, Steubenville
cards.access_notes: The official store page currently shows “Open Today Until 1:00 AM”; check the page when ordering because hours can vary.

cards.title: Wendy’s on Sunset Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 2206 Sunset Blvd, Steubenville
cards.notes: Choose dine-in, drive-thru, or applicable ordering options before midnight; the restaurant posts the same daily close time.
cards.short_summary: A listed midnight stop along Sunset Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 8 a.m.–12 a.m. every day at 2206 Sunset Blvd.
cards.access_notes: Posted restaurant and drive-thru hours are 8 a.m.–12 a.m. daily; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Eat’n Park at Fort Steuben Mall
cards.subtitle: 100 Mall Dr, Steubenville
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s pickup window or order ahead if you want food later in the evening; its posted hours run to 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A full-service and takeout option with an 11 p.m. posted close.
cards.evidence_claim: Eat’n Park lists its Steubenville restaurant at 100 Mall Dr as open 7 a.m.–11 p.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Posted business hours are 7 a.m.–11 p.m. daily; pickup window and delivery are listed services.

cards.title: Walmart Supercenter at Fort Steuben Mall
cards.subtitle: 100 Mall Dr, Steubenville
cards.notes: For groceries or supplies rather than a meal, plan the stop before 11 p.m.; individual in-store services close earlier.
cards.short_summary: A late evening option for food staples and practical supplies.
cards.evidence_claim: Walmart lists Steubenville Supercenter #2193 at 100 Mall Dr as open 6 a.m.–11 p.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Posted store hours are 6 a.m.–11 p.m. daily; departments and services have separate hours.

cards.title: KFC on Sunset Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 4187 Sunset Blvd, Steubenville
cards.notes: Use carryout, delivery, or the drive-thru before the posted 10:30 p.m. close, and confirm the service you need before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A Sunset Boulevard food stop listed through 10:30 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: KFC lists hours of 10:30 a.m.–10:30 p.m. every day for its 4187 Sunset Boulevard restaurant.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are 10:30 a.m.–10:30 p.m. daily; the location lists carryout, delivery, and drive-thru.

cards.title: China Garden
cards.subtitle: Steubenville, Ohio
cards.notes: Order pickup or local delivery from the restaurant’s own site; Friday and Saturday hours are posted until 10:30 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A locally operated pickup and delivery option that runs later on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: China Garden posts hours until 10:30 p.m. Friday and Saturday and until 10 p.m. Sunday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: 10:30 p.m. Friday–Saturday and 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday; pickup and delivery within seven miles are listed.

cards.title: The Ville Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 100 Mall Dr, Steubenville
cards.notes: For a seated or carry-out dinner, aim for Friday or Saturday when the kitchen is posted through 10 p.m.; confirm before departing.
cards.short_summary: A family-owned Fort Steuben Mall restaurant with a later weekend kitchen close.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ville posts kitchen hours of 11 a.m.–10 p.m. Friday and Saturday, with earlier closing times on other days.
cards.access_notes: Kitchen hours are posted until 10 p.m. Friday and Saturday; this card refers to restaurant food service, not the bar.

cards.title: McDonald’s on Sunset Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 2106 Sunset Blvd, Steubenville
cards.notes: This location is listed as open around the clock; use its drive-thru or ordering options and verify availability in real time.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour listed food stop on Sunset Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Apple Maps lists the McDonald’s at 2106 Sunset Blvd as open 24 hours every day, including drive-through service.
cards.access_notes: Apple Maps lists the restaurant and drive-through as open 24 hours daily; confirm live service availability before travel.

cards.title: Jimmy John’s at Franciscan Square
cards.subtitle: 225 Franciscan Sq, Steubenville
cards.notes: For an on-foot Franciscan Square food option, order pickup or delivery before 9 p.m.; the location also lists indoor seating.
cards.short_summary: A campus-adjacent sandwich shop with daily 9 p.m. service.
cards.evidence_claim: Jimmy John’s lists its 225 Franciscan Sq store hours and delivery hours as 10:30 a.m.–9 p.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Posted store and delivery hours are 10:30 a.m.–9 p.m. daily; delivery is subject to area availability.
